question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
How many tries did it take you to win?
Have you ever been in a fight?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Yeah... That's right... I know all about Travis.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: And I also know he's trying to move in on your girl!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: K... Kat?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: That's right, friend...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: I'd hustle back home real soon if you want to make sure he doesn't put the moves on her.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Anyway... I've got to head off and fight my own battles now.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: The rest is up to you...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: It's a long walk back to the Centerscore side of town... I'd get started now if I were you.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: It's noon now... And it'll be getting dark around 5:00.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I see... That means I'll have `20` fifteen-minute turns to get out of here!
nodes.text_bbcode: I see... That means I'll have [color=#e23b3b][i]20[/i][/color] fifteen-minute turns to get out of here!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Uh... Right. However you want to count it.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Anyway, once night falls... You're pretty much out of luck.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: The kids around here are pretty geeky and won't put up much of a fight...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: But as you walk home, you'll probably have to walk through some tougher neighborhoods...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But... But I'm a lover, not a fighter!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: No one wants to fight... But sometimes you have to!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Why would all these Wilson kids want to fight me anyway?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Because Wilson kids know that Centerscore High is a thousand times better than Wilson... And they hate us for it!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: For that reason, even the nerdiest of Wilson High kids will probably try to pick a fight with you.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Now... It's up to you how you want to spend your time...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: If you decide to `Walk a mile` you'll get closer to home. You'll probably need to go `10 miles` to get back to our side of town.
nodes.text_bbcode: If you decide to [color=#e23b3b][i]Walk a mile[/i][/color] you'll get closer to home. You'll probably need to go [color=#e23b3b][i]10 miles[/i][/color] to get back to our side of town.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Watch out though... Sometimes Wilson kids will jump you when you walk!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Other times it's best to stop and `Rest.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Other times it's best to stop and [color=#e23b3b][i]Rest.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Resting will let you heal up between fights, but don't do it too often, or you won't get out of here before nightfall!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Of course, there's always one more option... You can `Challenge a Wilson bully!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Of course, there's always one more option... You can [color=#e23b3b][i]Challenge a Wilson bully![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: I know, I know... Why look for a fight, right?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: By fighting a bully, you can learn a lot about how they fight.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You mean... A `special skill!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You mean... A [color=#e23b3b][i]special skill![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Uh... Yeah, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: I mean... It kind of makes sense, right? You only get tougher by fighting the strongest opponents!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Those 'special skills' might come in mighty handy down the road... Especially if you want to challenge Travis again!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Ha! You sure know a lot for a guy who just got his butt kicked by Travis!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Well, Brendan, I guess this is goodbye.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: I'd tell you to give me a call sometime, but I'm stealing your cell phone.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Say 'hi' to the Wilson kids for me...
A little while later...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Ugh...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Where... Where am I?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: You're on the wrong side of town.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: A... Andy? What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: I come here to train... To hone my fighting skills.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: I lost my eye fighting in this parking lot...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I thought you lost it in a slingshot accident.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Look... Are you going to let me give you some free advice or not?

nodes.prompt: Are you going to let me give you some free advice or not?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Are you going to let me give you some free advice or not?

nodes.title: `The Wrong Side of Town`
nodes.subtitle: Things are about to get dangerous...

nodes.text: At Centerscore High, before school...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh man... I can barely stand up...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I should have known better than to start playing `WarScrewdriver: Online` at midnight... I didn't sleep at all!
nodes.text_bbcode: I should have known better than to start playing [color=#e23b3b][i]WarScrewdriver: Online[/i][/color] at midnight... I didn't sleep at all!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But at least I gained three levels... And got a 'Blade of Penguin Slaying!'

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hehe. Yup. I'm pretty much the awesomest warrior on the face of the Earth! I'm sure to get reelected as `Clan Warchief` now!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hehe. Yup. I'm pretty much the awesomest warrior on the face of the Earth! I'm sure to get reelected as [color=#e23b3b][i]Clan Warchief[/i][/color] now!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Especially with Clan Empress 'KillerKitten13', A.K.A. my girlfriend Kat, backing my election bid!
Brendan turns... And runs right into Travis!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh... Sorry about that.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Sorry... Oh, you're gonna be sorry.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: You just picked a fight with the wrong guy!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh... Oh no. I didn't mean to...

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: I don't care what you meant. You started this fight...

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Now get ready to get pummeled like a man!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Mommy!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: If I'm going to be in a fight, I might as well think of it like `WarScrewdriver: Online...`
nodes.text_bbcode: If I'm going to be in a fight, I might as well think of it like [color=#e23b3b][i]WarScrewdriver: Online...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: So... I'm a first level nerd, with 15 life... And 7 attack strength!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Here goes nothing...

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: How can you still not be done with that stupid shawl?!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: You've been working on it all day...

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Hey... Wait a second! You just dropped a yak pelt!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: You've just been dropping items to buy time all day, haven't you?!

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Hehe. That's right.

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: That way, I can put off our clan vote forever!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Well, not anymore... It's time that `MomKisser11` ascended to his rightful place as `Warchief` of the `Highpants Kings!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, not anymore... It's time that [color=#e23b3b][i]MomKisser11[/i][/color] ascended to his rightful place as [color=#e23b3b][i]Warchief[/i][/color] of the [color=#e23b3b][i]Highpants Kings![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Uh... And then maybe we can go on a date to the taco stand?

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: ...And then `totally make out!`
nodes.text_bbcode: ...And then [color=#e23b3b][i]totally make out![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: With taco breath?

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: `I'll bring gum!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]I'll bring gum![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: It'll be a cold day in Hellzeroth before that happens.
Travis shoves past Kat and tries to click 'Vote for MomKisser11' with her character!

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: No!!!
Kat rushes past Travis...
And the computer crashes to the floor!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: But... But the vote!

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Better to break a library computer than vote for you!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Why you... I'm gonna drop you on the wrong side of town, just like your loser boyfriend!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Not so fast, Travis.

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Brendan! I knew you'd come for me!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: What the...?! How'd you make it back from the Wilson side of town?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Let's just say I've learned some new skills.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And it's time for some payback!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: You really think you can take me in a fight?

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: This isn't virtual reality, geek.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You're right, Travis. Things are about to get `real.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You're right, Travis. Things are about to get [color=#e23b3b][i]real.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Oh, this is `so` on.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, this is [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] on.

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Be careful, Brendan...
Kat kisses Brendan on the cheek.
...Then gets out of the way.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What a boost! I feel like Kat's kiss has restored me back to full life!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: I'm going to wipe that stupid grin off of your face!
Game over, man... Game over.
